subject: Matemática
description_pt: Ler e registrar medidas e intervalos de tempo em horas, minutos e segundos em situações relacionadas ao seu cotidiano, como informar os horários de início e término de realização de uma tarefa e sua duração.

components.description_pt: Ler e registrar medidas de tempo em horas, minutos e segundos
components.description_en: Read and record time measurements in hours, minutes, and seconds
components.cc_component_description: Identify relative sizes of time units (hours, minutes, seconds)

components.description_pt: Identificar o horário de início e término de uma tarefa cotidiana
components.description_en: Identify the start time and end time of an everyday task
components.cc_component_description: Write time on an analog clock, using a.m. and p.m. when appropriate, given a description of the time

components.description_pt: Calcular a duração de uma tarefa dado seu horário de início e término
components.description_en: Calculate the duration of a task given its start and end times
components.cc_component_description: Calculate the average rate of change over a specified interval of a function presented symbolically or in a table

cc_matches.description: Calculate and interpret the average rate of change of a function (presented symbolically or as a table) over a specified interval. Estimate the rate of change from a graph.
Tell and write time from analog and digital clocks to the nearest five minutes, using a.m. and p.m.

Know relative sizes of measurement units within one system of units including km, m, cm; kg, g; lb, oz.; l, ml; hr, min, sec. Within a single system of measurement, express measurements in a larger unit in terms of a smaller unit. Record measurement equivalents in a two column table. *For example, know that 1 ft is 12 times as long as 1 in. Express the length of a 4 ft snake as 48 in. Generate a conversion table for feet and inches listing the number pairs (1, 12), (2, 24), (3, 36), …*
